name: Pacer 9
blurb: Daily road trainer with a soft, durable foam. Wide toe box option. Built for high weekly mileage and long runs.

name: Glide Trainer
blurb: Max-cushion road trainer for long, easy miles. Roomy forefoot.

name: Tempo Lite
blurb: Light tempo shoe for faster sessions. Snug, narrow fit.

name: Aero Elite
blurb: Carbon-plated race shoe. Fast and bouncy, short lifespan.

name: Stride Daily
blurb: Firm, stable everyday trainer. Good for short easy runs, less forgiving on long runs.

name: Ridge Trail
blurb: Lugged trail shoe for dirt and rock. Heavy on pavement.

name: Cloud Cruiser
blurb: Plush cushioned trainer for long runs. Standard, narrow-ish fit.

name: Metro Flex
blurb: Minimal, flexible shoe for short runs and gym work. Little cushioning.

name: Tempo Wide
blurb: Plated tempo trainer in a wide fit. Snappy for workouts.

name: Long Haul
blurb: Durable high-mileage trainer. Wide fit. Ships from the warehouse in about a week.
